title: Aurelia 2048
description: Aurelia 2048 is a tile-sliding merge puzzle: combine matching numbers and push the board as far as it goes.

title: Aurora Grand: Virtual Piano — Free Classical Rhythm Game
description: Aurora Grand: Virtual Piano is a free classical rhythm game that sets you at a candlelit concert grand. Six glowing lanes fall toward a polished keyboard while original, fully synthesised piano arrangements of sixteen beloved classics fill the hall. Four programmes of four pieces each — from Ode to Joy and Für Elise to Clair de Lune, Flight of the Bumblebee and Rondo alla Turca. Chase three stars, climb seven ranks, then improvise in the Free Play studio. No install, no account, no backend — just the stage, the music and the next note.

title: Berry Wiggle
description: Berry Wiggle is a colorful casual rhythm game where squishy berries wiggle, bounce, and groove to the beat. Match the rhythm, follow the dance cues, and chain perfect wobbles to fill the dance floor with sweet energy. Easy to pick up, hard to put down—wiggle your way to the top of the berry leaderboard.

title: Bottle Drop
description: Bottle Drop is a cozy water-sort puzzle. Pour colored liquids between glass bottles, sort every bottle into a single pure color, uncover the mysterious "?" hidden layer, and take down the Drip King boss. Hand-drawn bottles, satisfying pour effects and a calm soundtrack make it the perfect little escape — bite-sized levels you can relax with anytime, anywhere.

title: Brick Out
description: BrickOut is a classic brick-breaking arcade game. Control your paddle, bounce the ball and smash all bricks!

title: Bubble Farm
description: A sunshine farm-themed bubble shooter game. Players aim and shoot cheerful fruit and veggie bubbles to match 3 or more of the same kind. Clear the board to harvest the level. Difficulty grows smoothly across 10 handcrafted levels, ending with two epic boss battles.

title: Count War
description: Count War 2 is a fast-paced casual strategy runner game. Lead your army through math gates to multiply your troops, avoid bad choices, and defeat enemy forces at the final battle!

title: Count War 2
description: Count War is a fun number-running strategy game. Pick math gates to grow your army and beat the enemy in the final fight!

title: Cryzen Arena
description: Cryzen Arena is a fast-paced sci-fi shooting arena game. Fight waves of enemies, grab powerful weapons and survive intense battles!

title: Drive Dash
description: Drive Dash is a free 3D slide-puzzle driving game. Pick a direction and your car or motorcycle slides across the grid until it slams into a wall. Plan your route, dodge walls and gaps, shove crates out of the way, and park in the finish zone using as few moves as you can.

title: Frogbound: River Crossing — Free 3D Frog Hopping Game
description: Frogbound: River Crossing is a free 3D arcade game about getting one small frog to the far bank. Sixteen hand-tuned crossings lie between the frog and the golden lily — sunlit meadow lanes, alder rapids, foggy marsh roads and the moonlit delta. Hop past cars, buses, tankers and drifting logs, grab the fireflies, and outsmart four old predators waiting at the end of the river. It runs right in your browser on desktop or mobile: no download, no account, no install.

title: Fruit Slasher
description: Fruit Slasher is a classic satisfying fruit cutting game. Swipe or slash to chop flying fruits into pieces, avoid bombs and aim for high combos and scores.

title: Gloop Quest
description: Gloop Quest is a cozy puzzle adventure game. Guide the cute gloop creature through tricky levels, solve puzzles and reach the goal!

title: Gold Miner
description: Gold Miner is a timeless classic arcade mining game. Control a swinging claw to dig gold nuggets, diamonds and treasure bags underground. Time your drops carefully, hit the money target before time runs out, buy useful tools and pass all mining levels. Simple but highly addictive!

title: Halloween Bubble Shooter
description: A Halloween-themed bubble shooter game. Players aim and shoot bubbles to match 3 or more bubbles of the same color. Clear all bubbles to complete the level. Difficulty increases as you progress through levels.

title: Halloween Memory
description: A moonlit manor, a deck of hand-painted pumpkins, witches and skeletons - find every pair before the candle burns down.

title: HAYHAUL — Pixel Farm Puzzle
description: HAYHAUL is a hand-painted pixel farm puzzle. Dispatch a fleet of tiny trucks to walk a flock of coloured ducks off barn-board artwork one by one, keep five parking slots moving, and out-honk Grandma Goose on the boss levels. 30 boards, 32 pixel paintings, four difficulty tiers. Free in your browser — no download, no account.

title: Hill Bus Rush
description: Hill Bus Rush is a fun hill-climb driving game. Drive your bus over bumpy hilly roads, keep balance and reach the finish safely!

title: Hollow Recovery
description: Hollow Recovery is a dark atmospheric survival adventure. Explore eerie ruins, gather resources and survive lurking threats.

title: Ink Storm — Free Doodle Drawing Survival Action Game
description: Ink Storm is a free, browser-based 2D drawing survival game where your pen is your only weapon. On a living notebook page you draw shapes to fend off endless waves of cute-but-relentless doodle monsters — slash, lasso, zap, storm and shield your way through the scribble storm. Manage your Ink, protect your Hearts, fill your Fever meter and chain combos, pick a power card after every level, and take on giant doodle bosses across four hand-drawn worlds. Runs in any browser on desktop or mobile — no download, no account.

title: Iron Front
description: Iron Front is a tactical crowd battle game. Recruit soldiers, expand your army and march forward to seize enemy bases. Make smart tactical choices and win the frontline battle!

title: Jellystorm — Free 3D Blocky FPS Arena Shooter
description: Jellystorm is a free 3D first-person wave shooter that runs right in your browser. Blast waves of wobbly jelly chunks across 16 blocky arenas, dodge boss shockwaves and upgrade your jelly drones between stages. No download, no login, no install — one HTML file and a browser is all you need.

title: Kandi Dash — A Sunny Meadow Run
description: Kandi Dash is a free cartoon-farm endless runner for your browser. Little Kandi sprints right through sunny meadows, babbling brooks, windy ridges, crow-filled sunsets and stormy fields — you only control the jump. Leap gaps, stomp moles and burrs, hoover up coins, ride floating hay bales, and face two bespoke boss fights on levels 5 and 10. No download, no account — tap and you're off.

title: Kinetic Forge
description: Kinetic Forge is a fast-paced arcade action game where you strike, flow, and combo through a neon-powered forge. Time your hits perfectly, chain rhythmic attacks, and turn raw momentum into devastating combo chains. The hotter the forge, the higher your score—master the rhythm, keep the heat rising, and prove you are the ultimate kinetic striker.

title: Lullaby Manor
description: Lullaby Manor is an atmospheric mystery puzzle game. Explore the old manor, search for clues, uncover hidden secrets and reveal the truth behind the strange lullaby.

title: Lumipop
description: Lumipop is a bright and relaxing bubble popping puzzle game. Match glowing bubbles, clear levels and enjoy satisfying pop effects!

title: Mad Shark
description: Mad Shark is an exciting arcade survival game. Control a fierce hungry shark swimming deep in the ocean. Eat fish, sea creatures and grow bigger while avoiding dangerous obstacles and human hunters. Grow into the most terrifying apex predator of the sea.

title: Mad Shark — Deep Sea Feeding Frenzy
description: Mad Shark is a free 2D feeding-frenzy arcade game that runs right in your browser. You're a hungry shark charging sideways through the deep ocean — chase fish, chomp submarines, dodge sea mines and torpedoes, grab power-ups and build a combo before the timer runs out. Reach the target score to clear each level, fight two big boss sharks along the way, and go wild in Rage mode. No download, no account, no install.

title: Midnight Manor — A Free 3D Haunted Escape Game
description: Midnight Manor is a free 3D horror escape game that runs right in your browser. The manor wakes at midnight — and the Keeper, its tireless old housekeeper, never sleeps. Sneak through 16 rooms of a decaying Victorian manor, collect keys, dodge her lantern glow, hide in wardrobes and escape before the timer runs out. No download, no install, no plugins — just you, the dark, and something that's always listening.

title: Moto Stunt Blitz
description: Moto Stunt Blitz is a thrilling motorcycle stunt game. Ride your dirt bike over crazy ramps, pull awesome stunts, balance carefully and reach the finish line safely.

title: New Fruit Slasher
description: Fruit Slasher is a juicy arcade fruit-slicing game in a cute western cartoon style. Satisfying swipe-to-slash mechanics, splashing juice, rhythmic fruit waves and a bright macaron-color palette set on a lively orchard backdrop (drifting clouds, fluttering butterflies, swaying grass and falling leaves) make it the perfect quick-play treat. Fully original art & audio, playable on desktop (mouse swipes) and mobile (touch swipes), instantly in the browser — no install needed.

title: Pantry Pairs
description: Pantry Pairs is a cozy memory match puzzle game. Flip over food tiles from the pantry, find matching pairs of fruits, snacks and kitchen ingredients. Clear all tiles with fewer tries to earn a better score. It’s calm, easy to learn and perfect for quick brain training.

title: Penalty Blitz 2026 — Free 3D Penalty Shooting Game
description: Penalty Blitz 2026 is a free 3D penalty shootout that runs right in your browser. Stand on the spot in a floodlit night stadium, pick your corner and swipe — the bend of your swipe becomes the curve of the ball. Curve around obstacles, hunt the bullseye, outscore fifteen rival strikers on the World Tour and finally break the Iron Wall boss. No download, no account, no install — load the page and take the shot.

title: Plumber Pipe
description: Plumber Pipe is a relaxing logic puzzle game. Rotate scattered pipe segments to build a continuous pipeline, and guide water from the source to the outlet.

title: Plumber Pipe
description: Plumber Pipe is a relaxing logic puzzle game. Rotate pipe segments to build a complete pipeline, let water flow smoothly from the source to the destination.

title: Pond Feast
description: Pond Feast is a fast-water arcade survival game. Control a hungry pond predator, eat smaller fish and aquatic creatures, grow larger, and survive against bigger enemies, fishing hooks, and dangerous traps. Become the deadliest feeder at the top of the food chain.

title: Ragdoll Frontline — Free 3D Ragdoll Battlefield Shooter
description: Ragdoll Frontline is a free browser-based 3D third-person battlefield defense shooter. You're a lone soldier holding the line across 16 realistic battlefields — desert highways, old-town ruins, frozen outposts, steel yards and black-rain nights — against wave after wave of enemy infantry. Every kill tumbles into full ragdoll physics: shotgun blasts and grenades launch bodies through the air. Every fourth operation brings a boss war vehicle, and between waves you spend requisition points on weapons, gadgets and permanent upgrades. No download, no install, no login.

title: Ranger vs Zombies
description: Ranger vs Zombies is an exciting zombie defense shooter. Control your ranger, fend off endless zombie waves and protect your base from being overrun.

title: Reef Blitz: Deep Sea Hunt
description: Reef Blitz: Deep Sea Hunt is a free arcade fishing shooter that runs straight from your browser. A brass harpoon cannon sits at the foot of the screen — swing it with the mouse, your finger or the arrow keys and pick which passing shoal is worth the next shot. Every harpoon costs coins and only a limited number are loaded, each reef has a haul quota to fill, and the purse belongs to that reef alone. Ten reefs, seven net powers, two abyss bosses and a golden coin-fish worth 400. No download, no account, no install.

title: Ringbound: Tangle Atelier
description: Ringbound is a hand-built 3D clay puzzle about the quiet pleasure of untangling. Turn clay rings, sweep their gaps across bronze clasps, free every loop on the potters' tray and shatter three Warden bosses. 30 levels, three assist tools, English and Chinese — all in a calm, sunny workshop. Free in your browser.

title: Royal Spider Solitaire — Free Classic Spider Solitaire Card Game
description: Royal Spider Solitaire is the classic Spider Solitaire dressed in a regal casino theme — an elegant deep-green velvet table, gold-trimmed cards and wine-red patterned backs. Assemble same-suit K-to-A runs, collect all eight and claim the table. It comes with a guided tutorial, three difficulty tiers, undo, hints, combo scoring and polished motion, and it runs right in your browser on desktop or mobile — no download, no install, no account.

title: Serpina — Greenhouse Serpent
description: Serpina is a sleek neon twist on the classic snake game. Guide the glowing serpent across the grid, collect glowing orbs to grow longer. Avoid hitting the walls or your own trail. Survive and rack up points as the game speeds up.

title: SKY BUDDIES
description: Sky Buddies is a friendly plane shooter where you fly solo or team up with a buddy on the same screen. Dodge incoming enemy bullets, grab weapon upgrades, blast enemy squadrons and take down powerful sky bosses. Simple drag controls make it easy for all ages to jump into the aerial battle.

title: Sky Buddies
description: Sky Buddies is a cute aerial shooting game. Fly together with your buddy in the starry sky. Dodge enemy bullets, collect power-ups, destroy enemy waves and take down huge sky bosses. Simple controls make it easy for players of all ages to enjoy the flight battle.

title: Sky Buddies: Cloud Patrol
description: Sky Buddies: Cloud Patrol is a free 3D cartoon vertical plane shooter for your browser. Fly a round little bear in a red-and-cream propeller plane above candy clouds, steer past frog, pig, cat and owl squadrons while your cannons fire by themselves, grab bullet orbs that swap your gun, evolve through five flight ranks, and fight a different sky pirate flagship every fourth wave. No download, no account — one tap and you're airborne.

title: Skyfang Strike
description: Skyfang Strike is a thrilling aerial shoot'em up. Pilot your fighter, dodge enemy fire and blast waves of foes out of the sky!

title: Stick Monkey
description: Stick Monkey rebuilds the classic "measure it, drop it, cross it" one-touch game with a new hero: a young monkey king carrying the golden staff. Press and hold and the staff grows out of the pillar under his feet. Let go and it topples forward into a bridge — if you judged the length right, he walks across. Too short or too long and the abyss wins.

title: Stickman Dismount
description: Stickman Dismount is a fun ragdoll physics simulation game. Launch your stickman, watch him tumble, bounce and crash through ramps, stairs and obstacles. Enjoy funny, chaotic physics moments and relax!

title: Stryke Arena — Free Browser FPS Arena Shooter
description: Stryke Arena is a fast, single-player first-person shooter that runs straight in your browser — no download, no login, no install. You're an independent operative dropped into hostile arenas across four warzones: a desert outpost, dusk-time urban ruins, an arctic convoy yard and a fortified night canyon. Militia squads attack in waves, and every fourth stage an armored boss commander takes the field — Dustdevil, Ironjaw, Frostbite and finally Goliath Prime. Three upgradeable weapons, an AI squad that fights beside you, and a meta-progression that makes every run count.

title: SWAT vs Zombies
description: SWAT vs Zombies is an intense top-down zombie shooter. Control a heavily armed SWAT officer, clear infected areas, survive endless zombie waves, upgrade your weapons and restore order to the city.

title: Tank Wars
description: Tank Wars: Steel Front is a thrilling tank combat game. Pilot your armored tank across the battlefield, destroy enemy tanks, dodge incoming shells and dominate the steel front.

title: THE CUBE 3D — Free 3D Rubik's Cube Puzzle in Your Browser
description: THE CUBE 3D is a high-quality web remake of the classic 3D Rubik's Cube puzzle, rendered in real time with WebGL — rounded stickers, silky plastic materials and true-to-life lighting under studio-grade three-point lights. It ships with 2x2, 3x3 and 4x4 cube sizes, three flip feels, adjustable scramble length, orthographic and perspective cameras, and seven color themes. A built-in timer, move counter and full stats board track your best, and unfinished games resume anytime. No downloads, no interruptions — play instantly in your browser on desktop or mobile.

title: Turbo Moto Rush — Free 3D Motorcycle Racing Game
description: Turbo Moto Rush is a free 3D arcade motorcycle racer that runs straight in your browser — no download, no launcher, no account. Ride a four-lane highway at up to 401 km/h, threading between sedans, SUVs, vans, trucks and buses, and every car you scrape past at full lean pays a near miss that feeds an x8 combo multiplier and your wallet. Sixteen original routes mix time-trials, head-to-head races against five tiers of AI bikers, and four boss fights against giant armoured haulers you beat by overtaking them clean while ramming their armour with nitro. Cash buys five bikes and four upgrade tracks, and when the campaign's done, Endless Sprint keeps generating traffic that thickens every 900 metres.

title: Viking Clash — Real-Time Card Battle Tower Defense
description: Viking Clash is a free real-time card-battle tower-defense web game set in the world of Norse Vikings. Lead your Viking clan into a fierce 3-minute siege in the fjord arena: play cards to summon warriors and spells, destroy the rival tribe's towers and defend your own King Tower. Two bespoke Viking-boss fights await on stages 5 and 10. No download, no account — a compact quick-fire campaign that runs right in your browser.

title: Viking Escape
description: Viking Escape is a fast-paced running adventure game. Help the brave viking run, jump and dodge dangers on his way to escape.

title: War Machine
description: War Machine is an exciting mech combat shooter. Control a powerful battle mech, blast enemy units, collect upgrades and crush all foes on the battlefield.

title: Zombie Buster
description: Zombie Buster is a fast top-down zombie survival shooter. Fight against endless undead hordes, unlock powerful weapons, pick up upgrades, and stay alive through increasingly brutal waves. Clear the arena and become the ultimate zombie buster!

title: Zombie Duck
description: Zombie Duck Hunter is a funny zombie duck shooting game. Take your gun, shoot down weird zombie ducks flying across the sky and stop them from reaching you.
